pr_title: fix(workflow): hide empty option for non-nullable select fields

comments.body: The empty option is now added only when `isNullable` is truthy (`isNullable ? [emptyOption, ...options] : options`). The PR says an unset prop keeps the old behaviour (`isNullable !== false`), but an undefined prop is now treated as non-nullable. Callers that never pass `isNullable` lose their "No value" choice. These include `FormCountrySelectInput.tsx:57`, `FormCallingCodeSelectInput.tsx:84`, `FormCurrencyFieldInput.tsx:60`, the cron form, and the other `FormSelectFieldInput` call sites. `FormCountrySelectInput.tsx:49` still handles `country === null` by calling `onChange('')`, but a user can no longer select that option, so they can't clear an already-chosen country, calling code or currency. `FormFieldInput` also passes `field.metadata?.isNullable`, which can be undefined. The fix is to use `isNullable !== false`.
